name: token-vault-poc
description: Token Vault POC: identity-aware credential authorization and brokering for applications and AI agents

scripts.dev: node scripts/setup.mjs && concurrently -k -n api,vault,web,cms-api,cms -c blue,magenta,green,yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w webhook" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w cms/api" "npm run dev -w cms/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w cms/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared -w sdk -w server -w webhook -w mcp -w client -w cms/api -w cms/client -w e2e
scripts.test: npm run test -w sdk -w server -w webhook -w mcp -w cms/api
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:migrate -w server && npm run db:migrate -w webhook && npm run db:migrate -w cms/api
scripts.db:init: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U token_vault -d postgres -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/pg-init.sql
